text: hey guys today we're making mapo tofu
you'll need about 400 grams of soft tofu
plus doubanjiang chili bean paste garlic ginger
first blanch the tofu cubes in salted water
then brown the pork in a hot wok
add the doubanjiang and aromatics fry until fragrant
pour in stock simmer and add the tofu gently
finish with cornstarch slurry and Sichuan pepper oil
serves two and takes about twenty five minutes
